feedback: The candidate faithfully encodes the task as a soft, capped objective and passes all checks. Fidelity: states u0/u1/u2 count distinct steps with holding_box (0/1/>=2) and uF is entered only on at_exit, matching 'walk to the exit; try to have the box in your hands on two different moves or more'. Since holding_box is persistent, each holding step fires exactly one counting transition (consecutive holds advance u0->u1->u2 on back-to-back steps; a re-pickup after a drop or a box_fell also advances correctly), and drops, falls, toggles, and siren events are all absorbed by the per-state else self-loops at zero reward, so every irrelevant event is covered and the transition relation is total, exclusive, and deterministic over all valuations. FINAL_STATES header is present and nonempty; uF is declared in STATES and is accepting: every at_exit valuation from every state has an explicit outgoing edge, so the exit is always rewarded (>= 1.0) and the machine cannot stall short of uF. Reward design is safe and path-consistent because the exit-step hold is folded into the terminal rewards: 0 holds -> 1.0; exactly 1 hold -> 1.1 total (either (u0, at_exit & holding_box)=1.1 or 0.1 + (u1, at_exit & !holding_box)=1.0); >= 2 holds -> 1.3 total (0.1 + 0.2 + 1.0 via u2, or 0.1 + (u1, at_exit & holding_box)=1.2 when the second hold is the exit step itself). Progress shaping is dense where the propositions allow (no distance/location predicates exist, so holding steps are the only measurable sub-goal) and strictly bounded: the count saturates at u2, self-loops pay nothing, the maximum total is 1.3, and the exit (>= 1.0) dominates the 0.3 of attainable shaping, so there is no incentive to farm holding or avoid the exit. Reachability holds (u1, u2, uF all reachable from u0; uF reachable from every state). No regressions are required since the hold count is a monotone historical achievement, and none are present, which is correct. Minor non-blocking note: (u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> 1.1 is unreachable in practice (holding first becomes true on a pickup step, which cannot coincide with the exit step; the box cannot fall on the step that ends the episode; and the exit is several moves from the start), but it is harmless defensive completeness that keeps the reward algebra total and also future-proofs the carry setup where the agent starts with the box. Format matches the paper template exactly (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES headers, (s, label) -> s' rows, (s, label, s') -> r rows, predicate-only labels using ! and &).
